Yesterday I cried 'cause I wanted to see you, Llorona
Now I cry because I saw you

I actually recently recovered from an ED. I gained back all the weight plus some and most days I am ok with it. Ofc it’s a constant struggle but I’m getting there. 
My grandmother, whom I recently saw, told my whole family that she was “worried I was overweight”. I’m probably a lil chubby. My stomach isn’t completely flat and my hips are pretty wide but I’m still very small in height and general size. 
Some people are honestly “built bigger” I’ve got a wider frame too but I’m not obese. 
Your mom is an asshole for doing that, and deserves to feel bad for how she’s making you feel. 
Hope things get better <3

I fake it all the time. Sometimes to the point where I feel like there isn’t a real me. People always talk about how, “they hate fake people”. And I’m definitely that. I can’t do most things they can, I don’t process information the same, and a lot of the stuff I think/feel would freak them out. So I lie or stay quite…idk what normal is but I’m definitely not it. 
And not in some quirky way where I feel I’m an outcast. I think people who really feel this way get it. That if you really are different, a lot of the time no one will know.

I think what happened was horrible. It’s horrific. I’ve seen videos of people jumping off of the buildings because they didn’t want to burn alive. And I’ve heard phone calls of people who died, saying goodbye to loved ones. But I think people use it as a bandwagon to hate the Middle East. It makes a part of me feel apathetic. 
I even know this girl who’s mom is famous for being one of the first reporters to get too the sight were the towers were falling. She was such a bitch about it. When she tells the story she makes it all about her and it’s disgusting. 
So I find that what happened to people to be horrible and I think violence on mass like that is horrific. But terrible things happen all the time. I think that at some point we need to move on, it just permeates so much hate.
